title: GroupRecord
description: One row of the groups table as surfaced by the API (ADR-0004 decision 3). A group is a named, owned, flat bag of user subjects. `active` is derived from `deleted_at` (empty string == active). The built-in world-readable 'public' group has id 'public', built_in true and an empty owner_subject; it is never member-editable and never deletable.

id.description: Opaque group id (a uuid4 hex for user-created groups; the fixed literal 'public' for the built-in group).

name.description: Human-readable group name, unique per owner among active groups.

owner_subject.description: Subject ('issuer:sub') of the creating user, who owns and manages the group. Empty string for the built-in public group.

built_in.description: True only for the reserved built-in 'public' group.

deleted_by.description: Subject that soft-deleted the group; empty string while active.

deleted_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the soft delete; empty string while active.

active.description: True when the group has not been soft-deleted (`deleted_at` is empty).
